title: Japanese Doll Diorama with Water Carrier Boy, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing a staged diorama composed of traditional Japanese Ningyo dolls. In the foreground, a boy doll clad in a patterned haori and headband carries two buckets balanced across his shoulder with a pole. Other Japanese female figures look on from a garden path and through an open window of a traditional building against a painted backdrop of nature.
